reference_issues.detail: Reference consumer -0.9% uses organic sales, which excludes both portfolio changes and currency translation. Excluding acquisitions/divestitures alone leaves currency effects: all four segments have negative growth (organic plus translation: -3.2%, -3.4%, -0.6%, -3.5%). Consumer is uniquely negative only under organic-sales interpretation. Gold preserved; no semantic validation.

assumptions: Use cost of products sold divided by arithmetic mean of opening and closing inventory, consistent with benchmark justification. The formula is not claimed to be printed in the source.
The 2022 earnings column and balance-sheet 2022/2021 columns identify the fiscal period; January 1, 2023 is the fiscal 2022 closing balance date.
Reported material inventories and cost of products sold support applicability of the requested inventory calculation; no claim of physical sales-unit count.
